title: Production mixed-slope richness scaling for Figure 2
purpose: Production-scale richness-scaling run for the main Figure 2 comparison under mixed response directions.
rationale: Refresh the Figure 2 richness pattern with the same 1000-replicate production convention used for Figure 1.
Keep this batch focused on the manuscript claim that richness buffers community variability when response directions are mixed.
Use S=2 through S=8 to preserve the current display range while removing Monte Carlo roughness from the richness curves.
Average over a shared non-negative rho_env grid so cross-richness comparisons avoid infeasible negative-correlation clipping and remain easy to explain.
Extend the core sigma_env range to 2.0, matching the high-resolution Figure 1 core boundary without folding in the Figure 1 stress-extension regime.
acceptance_checks: The combined parquet validates against the production manifest.
Rows equal 210000, with 1000 replicates for every scenario.
rho_eff and rho_clipped are present and manifest-consistent.
Mean extinction or floor occupancy is summarised by sigma_env and richness before replacing the Figure 2 display.
The production Figure 2 curve preserves the expected monotonic decline in mean CV_total with richness for sigma_env > 0.
